sentences.en: I intend to study the subject at a postgraduate level.
sentences.zh: 我打算在研究生阶段学习这门学科。

sentences.en: Postgraduate research is much more demanding than research at undergraduate level.
sentences.zh: 研究生研究要比本科研究难得多。

sentences.en: There are several ways to fund postgraduate study.
sentences.zh: 有几种方式可以资助研究生学习。

senses.zh: 大学毕业后的，大学研究院的
